domain: Genomic Research and Gene Association Studies
scenario:
An international genomic research organization is developing an enterprise-level platform to manage and analyze data related to Genome-Wide Association Studies (GWAS). This platform is intended to support researchers in identifying associations between genetic variants and phenotypic traits. The system will handle large datasets containing information about gene loci, related genes, and their respective research hits in scientific literature.

The platform needs to facilitate the storage and retrieval of complex genetic data, including details about each GWAS, gene loci, and corresponding genes. The system should also track the number of times these loci and genes have been referenced in scientific publications, providing insights into their relevance and research interest.

Additionally, the platform should support user management features that allow researchers to access, contribute to, and collaborate on the data. It must include robust search capabilities, allowing users to query data based on various criteria, such as gene identifiers, publication hits, and study types. The system should also have analytics and reporting tools to help researchers assess the impact of specific genes and studies.

The organization requires a secure and scalable infrastructure to manage this genomic data, ensuring data integrity and protecting sensitive information. The platform should also support integration with external databases and tools commonly used in genomic research.
